zoho.name: create_draft

attachments.description: Optional file attachments, including .ics files as UTF-8 text or Base64.

content_type.description: MIME type, e.g. text/calendar; charset=utf-8; method=REQUEST.

content_text.description: UTF-8 file contents, e.g. the full ICS string. Supply this OR content_base64.

content_base64.description: Base64 file bytes, including the content_base64 returned by White5 Square. No data URL prefix.

zoho.name: send_email
zoho.title: Send Zoho email
zoho.description: Sends from info@white5.ca with optional file attachments, including ICS text or Square Base64 metadata. Attachments require confirmed:true; otherwise returns a preview. For emails without attachments, call only after explicit user approval of recipients, subject, and body.

attachments.description: Optional file attachments, including .ics files as UTF-8 text or Base64.

content_type.description: MIME type, e.g. text/calendar; charset=utf-8; method=REQUEST.

content_text.description: UTF-8 file contents, e.g. the full ICS string. Supply this OR content_base64.

content_base64.description: Base64 file bytes, including the content_base64 returned by White5 Square. No data URL prefix.

confirmed.description: Set true only after the user approves recipients, subject, body and attachments. Otherwise attachment sends return a preview.

zoho.name: send_email_with_attachments
zoho.title: Send Zoho email with attachments
zoho.description: Sends an email with actual file attachments from info@white5.ca. Accepts calendar.ics as content_text or content_base64 from White5 Square. Returns a preview without uploading or sending unless confirmed:true after explicit user approval.

content_type.description: MIME type, e.g. text/calendar; charset=utf-8; method=REQUEST.

confirmed.description: Set true only after the user approves recipients, subject, body and attachments. Otherwise attachment sends return a preview.

zoho.name: reply_email
zoho.title: Reply to Zoho email

content_type.description: MIME type, e.g. text/calendar; charset=utf-8; method=REQUEST.

content_text.description: UTF-8 file contents, e.g. the full ICS string. Supply this OR content_base64.

confirmed.description: Set true only after the user approves recipients, subject, body and attachments. Otherwise attachment sends return a preview.

zoho.name: send_calendar_invite
zoho.title: Send calendar invitation
zoho.description: Builds and optionally sends a new RFC 5545 calendar invitation from info@white5.ca. Returns a preview unless confirmed is true.

end_datetime.description: Local end datetime. Provide this or duration_minutes.

confirmed.description: Must be true to send a real calendar invitation email.

zoho.name: update_calendar_invite
zoho.title: Update calendar invitation
zoho.description: Builds and optionally sends an RFC 5545 calendar invitation update. The original stable UID is required and reused.

end_datetime.description: Local end datetime. Provide this or duration_minutes.

confirmed.description: Must be true to send a real calendar invitation email.

uid.description: Original stable UID from the first invitation.

zoho.name: cancel_calendar_invite
zoho.title: Cancel calendar invitation
zoho.description: Builds and optionally sends an RFC 5545 calendar cancellation. The original stable UID is required and reused.

end_datetime.description: Local end datetime. Provide this or duration_minutes.

confirmed.description: Must be true to send a real calendar invitation email.

uid.description: Original stable UID from the first invitation.
